response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount, t.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM transaction_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), results AS (SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept_avg FROM (SELECT results.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM results) ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, transref;
